description: Requires an API key. The 100 most recent deposit requests with status (waiting, confirming, available, expired, under_review, reversed), amount_to_send, amount_received and credited_at. available = credited to balance.available. expired = the deadline passed without the exact amount arriving; if the user did send crypto, tell them to contact support with the transaction hash instead of opening a new request for the same transfer. under_review is a check, not a loss. Poll at most every 30-60 seconds.
name: lunium_list_usdt_deposits
title: USDT wallet deposits
